15752.Suggested use: As a dietary supplement for adults, take two (2) vegetable capsules daily, preferably at mealtime or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.
15752.Warnings: If you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications, planning any medical or surgical procedure or have any medical condition, please consult your healthcare practitioner before taking any dietary supplement. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature. Do not use if outer bottle seal is missing, torn or damaged in any way.
